skill.name: zach-listing-health-checker
skill.description: Checks Amazon listing health from a shopper view by fetching public product and search pages. It reviews visibility, price, seller, cart, delivery, category, ranking, reviews, and keyword search presence.
skill.summary: Checks public Amazon listing health signals and creates a Markdown diagnostic report.
skill.author: zach22-1999

security_audit.summary: The skill intentionally runs local Python scripts that fetch public Amazon pages, parse HTML, and write Markdown reports. Most static findings are false positives from Markdown backticks, readable Chinese text, User-Agent strings, or keyword variable names. Confirmed risks are limited to curl-based network egress and local report file reads or writes from a caller-provided output directory.

remediation.issue: External curl execution accepts a generic URL parameter.
remediation.suggestion: Restrict fetch_page to allowed Amazon domains, validate URL schemes, and consider a Python HTTP client to reduce PATH and subprocess risk.

remediation.issue: Report paths are built from user-controlled CLI values.
remediation.suggestion: Normalize output paths, reject path separators in seller and ASIN values, and keep report writes inside a dedicated output directory.

remediation.issue: Historical comparison scans local report files from a configurable directory.
remediation.suggestion: Limit history lookup to the report directory created by the skill and document what files may be read.

remediation.issue: Network scraping is central to the skill behavior.
remediation.suggestion: Document outbound Amazon requests clearly, keep throttling enabled, and avoid collecting pages outside public product or search results.

content.value_statement: Amazon operators need a fast way to verify whether a listing is visible, purchasable, and healthy from a shopper view. This skill fetches public Amazon pages, checks key listing signals, and creates a concise Markdown report.
actual_capabilities: Fetches public Amazon product pages for supported marketplace sites.
Extracts title, price, seller, cart, delivery, category, rank, rating, review, variant, and stock signals.
Checks keyword search visibility for target ASINs when keywords are provided.
Compares current results with previous local health reports.
Generates a Markdown health report with prioritized issues and a terminal summary.
limitations: It only analyzes public pages available at check time.
Amazon captcha, localization, or page layout changes can reduce extraction accuracy.
It does not use seller accounts, private APIs, or paid data sources.
Search results may differ by region, device, history, and timing.

use_cases.title: Validate a New Listing
use_cases.description: Check whether a newly launched ASIN is visible, purchasable, and correctly associated with the expected seller.

use_cases.title: Monitor Core ASINs
use_cases.description: Run periodic checks for price, cart, delivery, reviews, category, and search visibility changes.

use_cases.title: Investigate Sales Drops
use_cases.description: Review listing health signals when sales fall and identify buyer-facing issues that need manual action.

prompt_templates.title: Basic ASIN Check
prompt_templates.prompt: Check ASIN B0PUBLIC01 in the US marketplace for basic listing health.

prompt_templates.title: Seller Match Check
prompt_templates.prompt: Check ASIN B0PUBLIC01 on US and verify that the expected seller is YourBrand.

prompt_templates.title: Keyword Visibility Check
prompt_templates.prompt: Check ASIN B0PUBLIC01 on US for seller YourBrand and keywords wireless microphone, karaoke microphone.

prompt_templates.title: Batch Health Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Run a batch health check for B0PUBLIC01 and B0PUBLIC02 on US, compare with prior reports, and summarize priority issues.

output_examples.output: A report marks page access, price, cart, delivery, category, rank, reviews, and stock as pass, warning, or fail.

output_examples.input: ASIN B0PUBLIC01 with two search keywords.
output_examples.output: The report adds search visibility results and shows whether the ASIN appears organically, as sponsored, or not found.

output_examples.input: Two ASINs and an expected seller name.
output_examples.output: The report includes a comparison table, seller match status, and priority issues for each ASIN.

best_practices: Provide ASIN, marketplace code, expected seller, and core keywords in one request.
Treat reports as point-in-time snapshots and compare them with later checks.
Review captcha or missing-field warnings manually before acting.
anti_patterns: Do not treat search rank as stable across users, regions, or time.
Do not run frequent batch checks without throttling or operational approval.
Do not use this skill to scrape account, private, or customer-specific pages.

faq.question: Does this skill use Amazon seller credentials?
faq.answer: No. It reads public Amazon pages and does not log in to any account.

faq.question: Which marketplaces are supported?
faq.answer: It supports US, UK, GB, DE, FR, IT, ES, CA, JP, MX, and AU site codes.

faq.question: Can it check keyword visibility?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide comma-separated keywords, and it checks whether the ASIN appears on the first search results page.

faq.question: What output does it create?
faq.answer: It creates a Markdown health report and prints a concise terminal summary.

faq.question: Can it detect every listing problem?
faq.answer: No. It only detects signals visible in the fetched public pages at the time of the check.

faq.question: Why might fields be missing?
faq.answer: Amazon may show captcha pages, localized content, or layout variants that reduce extraction accuracy.
